title: Quantum Information at Infinity
summary: We introduce the Quantum Information Space at Infinity (Quinfinity) $\mathcal{Q}_\infty$ as the inverse limit of the symbolic Quantum $N$-Spaces $\mathcal{Q}_N$, identified with the complete local real algebra of formal power series under the adic topology. The pure state pro-variety is formalized as the inverse limit of $N$-level pure state varieties, driven by the algebraic colimit of a direct system of real radical ideals.
